settings.question: House rules
settings.answer:
• No smoking indoors
  • Quiet after 10 pm
  • Campfires in the pits only
  • Please take your boots off

settings.question: Cancellation
settings.answer: Free cancellation up to 14 days before arrival; after that the first night is kept.

settings.question: Pets and parking
settings.answer: Dogs welcome in the cabins, $25 a night, not in the farmhouse rooms. One car at each cabin, overflow by the barn.

settings.question: Privacy
settings.answer: We keep your name, email and dates to run your stay, and nothing else.
